paper_title: Search for dark photons using a multilayer dielectric haloscope equipped with a single-photon avalanche diode
notes: MuDHI multilayer dielectric haloscope at NYU Abu Dhabi searching for dark photon dark matter around 1.5 eV. 90% CL exclusion on kinetic mixing chi; the only explicit numerical value in the text is the minimum chi = 6.86e-11 at m_X = 1.61 eV/c^2. The full exclusion curve (Fig. 11) spans roughly 1.1-2.5 eV with boost-factor peaks concentrated in 1.4-1.8 eV, but no table of values is provided; digitized data reportedly available at the authors' GitHub repo. Appendix A states an assumed local DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm^3 for the flux formula used in setting limits (Eq. 17 quotes 0.45 GeV/cm^3 as a reference normalization only). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 1))
